rights.decision: The public repository does not grant reuse rights unless a later LICENSE file does so explicitly.

rights.assetClass: Third-party screenshots, copied text and stored model outputs
rights.decision: Publication requires verified provenance, clear attribution and the necessary provider, copyright and privacy permissions.

rights.assetClass: AI provider outputs and source lists used in a future site-run dataset
rights.decision: The live endpoint makes one transient provider request and keeps no raw server archive. Four reviewed OpenAI observations are published as a normalized owner-run fixture under OpenAI's customer-output rights. Google Grounded Results and Search Suggestions are not stored or published; Gemini local saves strip them before retaining query strings and run metadata.

The website uses system font fallbacks. Five text-free guide illustrations were commissioned by the owner through Higgsfield on 2026-08-27 and generated with nano_banana_2 after the requested model was adjusted by the service. Four additional topic-specific guide illustrations were commissioned directly by the owner through Google's gemini-3-pro-image model at native 2K on 2026-08-31; their prompts and generation metadata are stored with the project documentation. All nine illustrations are delivered locally as WebP files under public/images/guides and contain no copied third-party logos, screenshots or artwork.
Reference pages link to primary sources and paraphrase narrowly supported facts without republishing source documents or protected artwork.

rights.assetClass: User topic, selected mode/provider, language, country and transient fanout result
rights.decision: Input is transmitted to the ai-fanout.com endpoint and routed either directly to OpenAI or Google for native search, or through OpenRouter for modelled search ideas. The server stores no raw input or provider response. Only after an explicit save action may the visible result be retained in IndexedDB on that device for up to 30 days; it is not synchronized or reused as a shared cache.

The owner-operated Umami endpoint receives page analytics and only allowlisted product-event categories and bounded counts. URL search/hash values, raw keywords, provider outputs, query strings, source addresses, local-history content and user identifiers are excluded.

unknowns: Exact billed cost per OpenAI and Gemini run remains subject to provider-dashboard review; the UI shows a dated list-price estimate and the ledger retains a conservative EUR 0.10 reservation per Native Fanout request
Provider terms for transient processing across OpenRouter, OpenAI and Google require ongoing operator review
No public Gemini Grounded Result corpus or independent provider benchmark is authorized; the OpenAI-vs-Gemini page remains a local comparison protocol
Google Search Console post-change crawl and index state after an eventual safe production release
